description: Move units to an agent on another frame through the unit bridge: the amount is locked here and a wrapped balance of the same amount is issued on the target frame. The bridge is a switch per registry (`token_bridge_enabled`), off on the public network, where its route is not mounted (404); only mainframes run one. Requires agent JWT authentication.

amount.description: Amount to bridge, in this frame's units (at most 100000)

target_agent_did.description: DID of the receiving agent on the target frame

target_frame_url.description: Target frame federation URL (auto-resolved if omitted)

name: theprotocol_bridgeTransfer
title: Bridge Transfer
